analyst_view.overall: Manchester City are 7th on 9 points but drew 1-1 at home to Fulham on Saturday: four Premier League games without a win and nine straight games in all competitions without a clean sheet. Nunes and Khusanov were doubts before that game after injuries at Forest, Guehi had a small issue, and Semenyo is out until about mid-December (already counted). Napoli, 27th on 3 points, beat Torino 1-0 with a McTominay goal, but Antonio Vergara went off with a thigh problem, and Allegri said afterwards that Napoli should try to get a result at the Etihad but must prioritise Serie A. Lobotka, Meret and Buongiorno remain out, and Di Lorenzo's absence is already counted. No referee has been named.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals and already take off for Semenyo, Di Lorenzo and Lobotka. City keep conceding (nine games without a clean sheet), and Allegri's words about putting Serie A first hint that Napoli may rotate, which would make City's job easier more than it would reduce Napoli's chances. I go slightly higher, to about 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, with City around 6.7, and they already add about 10% for how many corners Napoli have been conceding. An Allegri side that defends deep gives up corners, but that is already in their record. I stay at 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards, with Napoli's higher recent count counted (+12%). Napoli reported no suspensions, City's doubts are all fitness ones, and no referee has been named. I stay at 3.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.6 shots and already add about 13% to City for the volume Napoli have been allowing. A partly rotated Napoli, with Vergara doubtful after his thigh problem, would likely sit even deeper, giving City more of the ball. I go a little higher, to about 29.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target, including Napoli's sharp recent finishing (+8%). City had 15 shots but only 3 on target against Fulham, so I keep the size small; Napoli's possible rotation still points slightly up, to about 10.6.
